panels.title: Power
panels.description: BAT_POWER_W (+ charging), SOLAR_POWER_W, LOAD_W - mean per bucket

targets.rawQueryText:
-- raw up to 2 days, agg_15min beyond, one value per (CET) day beyond 60 days
WITH q AS (SELECT $__from / 1000 AS f, $__to / 1000 AS t, $__interval_ms / 1000 AS i),
src AS (
  SELECT v.name, x.ts, x.value, max(q.i, v.log_s) AS b
  FROM q, vars v CROSS JOIN raw x ON x.var_id = v.id AND x.ts >= q.f AND x.ts < q.t
  WHERE v.name IN ('BAT_POWER_W', 'SOLAR_POWER_W', 'LOAD_W') AND q.t - q.f <= 172800
  UNION ALL
  SELECT v.name, x.ts, x.value, CASE WHEN q.t - q.f > 5184000 THEN 86400 ELSE max(q.i, 900) END
  FROM q, vars v CROSS JOIN agg_15min x ON x.var_id = v.id AND x.ts >= q.f AND x.ts < q.t
  WHERE v.name IN ('BAT_POWER_W', 'SOLAR_POWER_W', 'LOAD_W') AND q.t - q.f > 172800
)
SELECT CASE WHEN b >= 86400 THEN ts - (ts + 3600) % 86400 ELSE ts - ts % b END AS time,
       name, AVG(value) AS value
FROM src
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Energy per hour
panels.description: From agg_15min (the current 15 min are not in yet)

targets.rawQueryText:
-- kWh per local hour: SUM of the 15 min increments of the counters
WITH q AS (SELECT $__from / 1000 AS f, $__to / 1000 AS t, $__interval_ms / 1000 AS i)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT x.ts - x.ts % 3600 AS time, 'Consumption (LLOAD1+2)' AS name, SUM(x.value) / 1000.0 AS value
  FROM q, vars v CROSS JOIN agg_15min x ON x.var_id = v.id AND x.ts >= q.f - q.f % 3600 + 3600 AND x.ts < q.t
  WHERE v.name IN ('LLOAD1_CONS_WH', 'LLOAD2_CONS_WH')
  GROUP BY 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT x.ts - x.ts % 3600 AS time, 'PV production (LPV1+2)' AS name, SUM(x.value) / 1000.0 AS value
  FROM q, vars v CROSS JOIN agg_15min x ON x.var_id = v.id AND x.ts >= q.f - q.f % 3600 + 3600 AND x.ts < q.t
  WHERE v.name IN ('LPV1_PROD_WH', 'LPV2_PROD_WH')
  GROUP BY 1
) ORDER BY 1

-- kWh per local day: SUM of the 15 min increments of the counters
WITH q AS (SELECT $__from / 1000 AS f, $__to / 1000 AS t, $__interval_ms / 1000 AS i)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(x.ts, 'unixepoch', 'localtime'), 'utc') AS INTEGER) AS time, 'Consumption (LLOAD1+2)' AS name, SUM(x.value) / 1000.0 AS value
  FROM q, vars v CROSS JOIN agg_15min x ON x.var_id = v.id AND x.ts >= CAST(strftime('%s', date(q.f, 'unixepoch', 'localtime', '+1 day'), 'utc') AS INTEGER) AND x.ts < q.t
  WHERE v.name IN ('LLOAD1_CONS_WH', 'LLOAD2_CONS_WH')

src AS (
  SELECT v.name, x.ts, x.value, max(q.i, v.log_s) AS b
  FROM q, vars v CROSS JOIN raw x ON x.var_id = v.id AND x.ts >= q.f AND x.ts < q.t
  WHERE v.name IN ('POW_AC300_W', 'POW_AC3KW_W', 'POW_AC5KW_W', 'POW_FRIDGE_W', 'POW_KITCHEN_W', 'POW_WASCHMACHINE_W', 'POW_OTHER_W', 'POW_TECHM_W', 'POW_AXPERT_W', 'POW_EVSE_W', 'POW_WS_HEATING_W') AND q.t - q.f <= 172800
  UNION ALL
  SELECT v.name, x.ts, x.value, CASE WHEN q.t - q.f > 5184000 THEN 86400 ELSE max(q.i, 900) END
  FROM q, vars v CROSS JOIN agg_15min x ON x.var_id = v.id AND x.ts >= q.f AND x.ts < q.t
  WHERE v.name IN ('POW_AC300_W', 'POW_AC3KW_W', 'POW_AC5KW_W', 'POW_FRIDGE_W', 'POW_KITCHEN_W', 'POW_WASCHMACHINE_W', 'POW_OTHER_W', 'POW_TECHM_W', 'POW_AXPERT_W', 'POW_EVSE_W', 'POW_WS_HEATING_W') AND q.t - q.f > 172800
)
SELECT CASE WHEN b >= 86400 THEN ts - (ts + 3600) % 86400 ELSE ts - ts % b END AS time,
       name, AVG(value) AS value
FROM src
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1
